triangulation.description: Whether this sale is the intermediary's (B) leg of a triangular intra-Community transaction (arts. 141/197); enables the triangulation-simplification and reverse-charge checks.
triangulation.title: Triangulation

intermediaryCountryCode.description: Member State of the intermediary (B) in a triangular transaction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); must differ from the seller and final-customer Member States (art. 141).
intermediaryCountryCode.title: Intermediary Country Code

finalCustomerCountryCode.description: Member State of the final customer (C) in a triangular transaction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); must differ from the seller and intermediary Member States (art. 141).
finalCustomerCountryCode.title: Final Customer Country Code

finalCustomerVatId.description: VAT identification number of the final customer (C) who accounts for the VAT under reverse charge in a triangular transaction (art. 141).
finalCustomerVatId.title: Final Customer VAT ID

directDelivery.description: Whether the goods are dispatched/transported directly to the final customer (C) in a triangular transaction (art. 141 condition).
directDelivery.title: Direct Delivery

reverseChargeMention.description: Whether the invoice carries the reverse-charge mention required where the customer is liable for the VAT (arts. 197/226(11a)).
reverseChargeMention.title: Reverse Charge Mention

invoiceNote.description: Free-text invoice note; may carry the reverse-charge wording ('Reverse charge' / 'btw verlegd').
invoiceNote.title: Invoice Note

smeExemptionApplied.description: Whether the small-enterprise VAT exemption (art. 282) is applied to this supply; enables the SME turnover-threshold check.
smeExemptionApplied.title: Sme Exemption Applied

annualTurnover.description: The taxable person's annual turnover, used to test the small-enterprise exemption against the national threshold (art. 282).
annualTurnover.title: Annual Turnover

smeThreshold.description: The national small-enterprise turnover threshold below which the exemption is available (art. 282).
smeThreshold.title: Sme Threshold

crossBorderSme.description: Whether the cross-border Union SME scheme is used; if so the Union-wide turnover must not exceed EUR 100 000 (art. 282).
crossBorderSme.title: Cross Border Sme

unionTurnover.description: The taxable person's Union-wide annual turnover, capped at EUR 100 000 for the cross-border SME scheme (art. 282).
unionTurnover.title: Union Turnover

mixedUse.description: Whether the purchase is used for both deductible and non-deductible transactions, triggering pro-rata deduction (art. 173).
mixedUse.title: Mixed Use

proRataPercent.description: Deductible proportion (0..100) of the input VAT under the pro-rata rule (art. 173).
proRataPercent.title: Pro Rata Percent

taxAmount.description: Input (purchase) VAT amount on the transaction, the base for the pro-rata deductible amount (art. 173).
taxAmount.title: Tax Amount

deductibleVatAmount.description: The deductible portion of the input VAT = taxAmount x proRataPercent / 100 (art. 173).
deductibleVatAmount.title: Deductible VAT Amount

deductionAdjusted.description: Whether the initial deduction has been adjusted because it was higher or lower than the entitlement (art. 184).
deductionAdjusted.title: Deduction Adjusted

adjustmentAmount.description: The amount by which the initial deduction is adjusted (art. 184); positive increases, negative decreases the deduction.
adjustmentAmount.title: Adjustment Amount

capitalGood.description: Whether the purchase is a capital good subject to the multi-year deduction-adjustment (revision) period (art. 184).
capitalGood.title: Capital Good

adjustmentPeriodYears.description: The capital-goods revision period in whole years over which the deduction is adjusted (art. 184; NL 5y movables, 10y immovable property).
adjustmentPeriodYears.title: Adjustment Period Years

fecExport.description: FR Fichier des Écritures Comptables (FEC) export descriptor: the technical format and file name of the audit export for this entry's accounting file (fr-fec-format).

fileType.description: Export file type: a flat text file or XML.
fileType.title: File Type

delimiter.description: Field delimiter of the flat file: tab or pipe.
delimiter.title: Delimiter

encoding.description: Character encoding of the file (e.g. iso-8859-15, utf-8).
encoding.title: Encoding

fileName.description: File name in the mandated form SIREN (9 digits) + 'FEC' + closing date (YYYYMMDD) + extension, e.g. 123456789FEC20261231.txt.
fileName.title: File Name

fecExport.title: Fec Export

nf525Closing.description: FR NF525 certified-software periodic closing record (grand total perpétuel): the secured, archived closing totals chained as an unbroken sequence (fr-nf525-secured-archive).

period.description: Closing period the total covers: daily, monthly or annual.
period.title: Period

perpetualTotal.description: The perpetual running total (grand total perpétuel) at this closing.
perpetualTotal.title: Perpetual Total

sequenceNumber.description: Gapless sequence number of the closing record, evidencing an unbroken chain.
sequenceNumber.title: Sequence Number

signature.description: Integrity signature/hash securing the closing record against alteration.
signature.title: Signature

nf525Closing.title: Nf525Closing

ptChain.description: PT certified-invoicing chain link: the ATCUD and chained hash ensuring an unbroken, tamper-evident document sequence (pt-certified-invoicing-software).

atcud.description: ATCUD unique document code issued for the certified document.
atcud.title: Atcud

hash.description: Hash of this document, computed over its content and the previous document's hash.
hash.title: Hash

previousHash.description: Hash of the previous document in the chain, linking the sequence.
previousHash.title: Previous Hash

ptChain.title: Pt Chain

BbvStatement.title: BBV Statement
BbvStatement.description: An NL public-sector budget (begroting) or annual-accounts (jaarstukken) statement for one fiscal year of a municipality, province or water authority, used by the public-sector rule domain to evaluate the BBV (Besluit begroting en verantwoording) composition (arts. 7/8/24), the mandatory paragraphs (art. 9), the taakvelden overview and the asset capitalisation/valuation rules (arts. 59/62). Per ADR-022 this is a register object, not an embedded structure.

documentType.description: Which BBV document this statement represents: a budget (begroting) or the annual accounts (jaarstukken).
documentType.title: Document Type

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 jurisdiction; BBV applies to NL public bodies.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

entityType.description: Type of NL public body the BBV governs: gemeente (municipality), province (province) or waterAuthority (water authority).
entityType.title: Entity Type

fiscalYear.description: The fiscal year the budget or annual accounts cover.
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency the statement is presented in (EUR for NL public bodies).
currency.title: Currency

parts.description: The top-level component parts present. For a begroting (art. 7): beleidsbegroting + financielebegroting. For jaarstukken (art. 24): jaarverslag + jaarrekening.
parts.title: Parts

programmePlan.description: The programme plan of a begroting (art. 8 BBV): the programmes plus the algemene dekkingsmiddelen, overhead, VPB charge and the amount for unforeseen expenditure (onvoorzien).

generalFundingSources.description: Overview of general cover funds (algemene dekkingsmiddelen).
generalFundingSources.title: Algemene Dekkingsmiddelen

programmePlan.title: Programmaplan

paragraphs.description: The mandatory BBV paragraphs (art. 9): lokale heffingen (local levies), weerstandsvermogen (resilience capacity), onderhoud kapitaalgoederen (maintenance of capital goods), financiering, bedrijfsvoering (operational management), verbonden partijen (related parties), grondbeleid (land policy).
paragraphs.title: Paragraphs

annualAccounts.description: The financial statements of the jaarstukken (art. 24 BBV): the overview of revenues and expenses, the balance sheet, the lawfulness statement (rechtmatigheidsverantwoording) and the auditor's report (accountantsverklaring).

overviewRevenueExpenses.description: Overview of revenues and expenses present.
overviewRevenueExpenses.title: Overzicht Baten Lasten

annualAccounts.title: Jaarrekening

fixedAssets.description: Tangible and intangible fixed assets (arts. 59/62 BBV): each meeting the activation criteria is capitalised (geactiveerd) and valued at acquisition or production cost (verkrijgings- of vervaardigingsprijs).

capitalised.description: True when the asset is capitalised (geactiveerd) on the balance sheet (art. 59).
capitalised.title: Capitalised

acquisitionCost.description: Acquisition or production cost (verkrijgings- of vervaardigingsprijs) (art. 62).
acquisitionCost.title: Acquisition Cost

valuationBasis.description: Valuation basis: acquisition or production cost.
valuationBasis.title: Valuation Basis

fixedAssets.title: Fixed Assets

taskFields.description: Mandatory overview of estimated revenues and expenses per taakveld (task field), enabling inter-municipal comparison (bbv-taakvelden-overview).
taskFields.title: Taakvelden

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a BBV Statement is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
